Utente.heading: Portal do Contribuinte — service guide
Utente.intro: A simple summary of the main Portal do Contribuinte services (Angola's Ministry of Finance), with direct access to each one.
Utente.disclaimer: This space is informational only and independent — it is not affiliated with the Ministry of Finance. We do not collect any personal or tax data here. To look up, register, or pay, always use the official Minfin site through the links below.

cadastro.descricao: Registration of individual and corporate taxpayers with the Ministry of Finance.

liquidacoes.descricao: Lookup and issuance of tax amounts owed.

pagamentos.descricao: Payment of taxes and fees through authorized entities.

certificado.descricao: Validation of certificates issued by the Portal do Contribuinte.

produtoresSoftware.descricao: Registration and management for certified invoicing software producers.

graficasTipografias.descricao: Registration and management for printers authorized to issue tax documents.

validarDocumentos.descricao: Validation of tax documents issued through the portal.

Site.metaTitle: Plum Angola — Websites, online stores, AI chatbots & automation
Site.metaDescription: IT and AI services from Angola to the world: websites, online stores, AI chatbots, automation, custom systems, support, consulting and training. Clear pricing in Kz and USD.

hero.title: Technology that helps your business sell more.
hero.subtitle: Websites, online stores, AI chatbots and automation for businesses in Angola and abroad. Clear pricing in kwanzas and US dollars, and direct contact with the people doing the work.

offer.title: Launch offer
offer.text: 20% off the implementation fee for our first 10 clients or until 31 March 2027, plus the 1st month free on monthly plans. Not combinable with other offers; does not apply to third-party costs. Eligibility is confirmed in the proposal.

services.title: Services & packages
services.subtitle: Three packages per service — Basic, Professional and Premium. Prices exclude VAT, per our 2026/2027 price list.
services.rateNote: USD amounts are approximate, at the BNA reference rate: 1 USD = {rate} Kz ({date}). The contract price is the Kz amount. Price list valid until {validUntil}.

pay.error: We couldn't start the payment. Please try again or contact us.
pay.testMode: Payments in test mode — no real money is charged.

how.title: How it works
steps: Pick a package or request a quote — we reply within 24 business hours.
We confirm the scope in a proposal (valid for 30 days).
Pay the deposit: 50% upfront (projects up to 500,000 Kz) — online by card or by bank transfer/Multicaixa Express.
We build and deliver; you pay the balance on delivery. Once paid in full, the solution and data are yours.
how.terms: Projects above 500,000 Kz: 40% upfront, 30% on prototype approval and 30% on delivery. Monthly plans are paid in advance, no lock-in. Any discounts are applied to the final payment.
